name: Dr. Sarah Chen
title: Head of Mathematics & Biology
bio: Dr. Chen holds a Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics from MIT and has 15 years of teaching experience. Her innovative visual teaching methods have helped over 5,000 students achieve top scores in competitive exams. She believes every student can fall in love with numbers.

name: Prof. James Wright
title: Senior Physics Faculty
bio: Professor Wright spent 10 years at CERN before joining PrismTutor Studio. His ability to explain complex physics concepts through everyday analogies and visual experiments makes him one of the most sought-after physics teachers in the country.

name: Dr. Priya Sharma
title: Chemistry Department Head
bio: Dr. Sharma's passion for chemistry is infectious. With a background in pharmaceutical research, she brings real-world applications into every lesson. Her 3D molecular modeling sessions are legendary among students.

name: Ms. Elena Ross
title: English & Humanities Faculty
bio: Elena is a published novelist and former journalist who brings storytelling into education. Her creative writing workshops have produced award-winning student writers, and her literature classes are known for lively debates and deep analysis.

name: Mr. Alex Kumar
title: Computer Science & Math Faculty
bio: Alex transitioned from a successful career at Google to teaching the next generation of programmers. He combines industry experience with academic rigor to create courses that are both practical and intellectually stimulating.
